note: Your steps (hub/steps.html): the owner's open to-dos in order. Source: STATE.md 'Waiting on the owner' and the docs named in each src. The lead keeps it current. No account ids, no addresses: <your PC link> stands for your own PC link.

items.title: Add the Rapid EOD 25K
items.what: Tell the bot about your new Rapid EOD 25K account so it starts trading it.
items.why: This is the account with the $500 daily loss limit (a soft pause); the bot already sizes to stay above it. Until it is added it trades nothing.
steps: Turn Tailscale on. Open the line below in your browser.
Pick Rapid EOD 25K, tap the account name in the list.
Type I ACCEPT LIVE RISK, press Add. It waits for the bot to be flat, then starts by itself.
items.copy_note: The phrase to type. The page is: <your PC link>:8444/add-account/

items.title: ATLAS keeps trading under $100 of room
items.what: Let ATLAS keep taking trades even when less than $100 of room is left.
items.why: You said yes on Nov 19. Without it ATLAS stops early and misses winners.
steps: At the PC, wait until ATLAS is flat (no open trade).
Open a terminal in the bot folder and run the line below.
It prints the new setting. Nothing else to do.
items.copy_note: Run it at the PC only when ATLAS is flat.

items.title: Phone Remote, one time
items.what: Tell the phone app which repo to send commands through.
items.why: After this, Update now / Pause / Flatten / Status work from the phone when you cannot reach the PC. Safety, not money.
steps: In the repo box type your Olympus repo (owner/olympus), the way you named it on GitHub.
Tap Save repo. It is kept on that phone only.
items.copy_note: Replace owner with your own GitHub name; the box remembers it.

items.title: Kalshi K8 live, Monday before 4:44 PM ET
items.what: Give the Kalshi bot a key and start it with real money, $2.50 a bet.
items.why: Monday's windows only trade if it is on before 4:44 PM ET. Real money: the loss is limited to what you put in.
steps: kalshi.com > Profile Settings > API Keys > Create. Never paste the key in chat.
Open <your PC link>:8444/kalshi-live/ and paste the key there, Save.
Pick $2.50 (marked the rule), type the phrase below, tap Start LIVE.

items.title: Optional: test the 50K combo in Sim
items.what: Try the 50K combo on the practice account (Sim101) first. Then, after one Sim day, turn on fast entry.
items.why: No real money in Sim. It shows whether the combo and the faster entry behave before they touch a funded account.
steps: At the PC, run the first line below (Sim101 only).
Let it run one Sim day.
Then, if it looked fine, run the fast entry line (second one).
items.copy_note: First line: the combo on Sim101. Second line (copy2): fast entry, after one Sim day.

items.title: Keep the PC and NinjaTrader on, 02:00 to 15:30 ET
items.what: Do not sleep or close the PC or NinjaTrader on trading days.
items.why: Nov 10 and 11 trades were missed because the PC was silent. A silent PC is a missed trade, and a missed trade is missed $.
steps: Leave the PC on and awake from 02:00 to 15:30 ET, Monday to Friday.
Check from the phone any time with the line below.
items.copy_note: At the PC: a health check. Your phone also warns when the PC goes silent.
